## fetchAccrualPosition() function

Fetches a Midnight position paired with its hydrated market.

Reads the full inventory of `fetchPosition` and `fetchMarket` at the same call parameters: `eth_chainId` only when needed, `Midnight.toMarket(marketId)`<!-- -->, `Midnight.marketState(marketId)`<!-- -->, and either deployless `GetPosition.query(midnight, marketId, user)` or direct `Midnight.position(marketId, user)` plus all collateral slots.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function fetchAccrualPosition(client: Client, params: MidnightFetchParams & {
    readonly marketId: Hash;
    readonly user: Address;
}): Promise<AccrualPosition>;
```

Accrual position instance.

## Exceptions

`UnsupportedChainIdError` when no address registry exists for the client chain id.

`UnknownAddressError` when the registry has no Midnight address for the client chain id.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.marketId`<!-- -->: Market id whose position and market state to read.

- `params.user`<!-- -->: Position owner address.

- `params.deployless`<!-- -->: Optional deployless mode for the position read; defaults to `true` with fallback, or `"force"` without fallback.

- `params.account`<!-- -->: Optional account used as the `from` field for the reads.

- `params.blockNumber`<!-- -->: Optional block number used for the reads.

- `params.blockTag`<!-- -->: Optional block tag used for the reads.

- `params.stateOverride`<!-- -->: Optional state override set used for the reads.

## Example


```ts
import { fetchAccrualPosition } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";
import { createPublicClient, http } from "viem";
import { base } from "viem/chains";

const client = createPublicClient({ chain: base, transport: http() });
const position = await fetchAccrualPosition(client, {
  marketId: "0x12590ae1aee324a005be565f3bcdd16dbf8daf7969b26c181c8b8f467dad9f67",
  user: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000009000",
});
console.log(position.market.id);
```
